text:
The least likely statement is **"Law is the deliberate expression of a sovereign's will."** Savigny held that law grows organically from a people's shared spirit (Volksgeist) and custom, not from deliberate command, so this is the view he would reject. The other option, that a society's law reflects its culture, follows directly from his view. I only have these two options, not the full list, so my confidence is limited.

CONFIDENCE: 85
